experimental_design: inferred: Here, we combine comparative proteomics and genomics analysis of chromatin in eukaryotes and archaea.
factor_value: inferred: We retrieved the protein sequences of the canonical histones identified in each of the 26 species and we used them for the proteomic analysis of hPTMs.
number_of_fractions: A 2-μg aliquot of the peptide mixture was analyzed using a LTQ-Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) coupled to an EASY-nLC 1000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) with both collision induced dissociation (CID) and high energy collision dissociation (HCD) fragmentation.
number_of_samples: In addition to the 19 used in our proteomics survey, we also included previously published hPTM data from the following species (Supplementary Data 1c): the brown alga Ectocarpus siliculosus, the diatom Phaeodactylum tricornutum, the ciliate Tetrahymena thermophila, the ascomycete Neurospora crassa, Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Schizosaccharomyces pombe, and the plant Arabidopsis thaliana.
technology_type: Histones samples were quantified by the BCA method and 10 μg of each sample were derivatized with propionic anhydride, digested with trypsin and derivatized again with phenylisocyanate as previously described.
